Blackwing pencils are ideal for illustrators and writers who prefer a soft, dark line. These Pearl pencils are crafted from incense cedar wood with a sleek, pearl-white finish. The unique rectangular white eraser can be extended as it wears down from use, and also pops out completely from the pencil body for replacement. The eraser is latex free, and replacement erasers are available in a variety of colors.

Blackwing pencils differ in the softness of the graphite core, which can be felt while writing and drawing. These pencils feature a balanced core that is smooth and dark yet holds a strong point.

These pencils were previously known as Palomino Blackwing Pencils.

# Blackwing Pearl Pencils - Set of 12
Brand: Blackwing
Category: Pencils > Wooden Lead Pencils

## Features
PENCILS WITH HERITAGE – First created in the 1930’s, Blackwing built a following that included John Steinbeck and Chuck Jones, who proudly used Blackwings to create Bugs Bunny and many other Looney Tunes characters. Discontinued in the 90’s, devotees paid as much as $40 a pencil. In 2010, we revived the Blackwing brand for a new generation of writers, musicians, and others seeking a more natural existence.; PERFECT FOR ILLUSTRATORS AND CALLIGRAPHERS – With our balanced and smooth Japanese graphite core, Blackwing Pearl pencils are perfect for illustrators, UI/UX designers, and woodworkers. Use for a line that is softer than the Blackwing 602, but firmer than the Blackwing, and all without excessive sharpening.; UNIQUE ICONIC DESIGN – Blackwing’s unique and iconic rectangular erasers are synonymous with quality. Each of our pencils features a specially designed ferrule, allowing you to extend or replace the eraser.; COMMITMENT TO QUALITY – Blackwing Pearl pencils are made with the finest materials in the world, including Genuine Incense-cedar from California and premium Japanese graphite.; HOW WE GIVE BACK – A portion of the sales from all Blackwing products benefit the Blackwing Foundation, which funds and develops arts and music education at the K-12 level. Your purchase helps provide, among other things, the instruction, learning environment and instruments children need to participate in the Little Kids’ Rock Modern Band Program.

# Blackwing - Pearl (Pack of 12)

## $40.00 

Blackwing Pearl (Pack of 12) Feature's Blackwing's Balanced graphite.

Made from California Genuine Incense-Cedar and premium Japanese graphite. Claimed by many to be the best writing pencil in the world, Blackwing pencils are famous for the quality of graphite, iconic shape, replaceable eraser, and the men and women whose works they’ve inspired throughout the years. The Blackwing Pearl features the ultimate balance in graphite core, right in between the "firm and smooth" of the Blackwing 602 and the "soft and smooth" of the Blackwing Matte. In a pearl white finish with a white eraser that is easily adjusted, extended or replaced. 

The packaging doubles as a gift box and pencil cup. The Pearl is ideal for writers, artists, and letterers who enjoy a balanced writing experience. Available in a 12-pack for artists and writers who need enough pencils to get through the day.

Great pencil for sketching

This pencil feels great in the hand and looks good on paper. Blackwing doesn’t rate the hardness of their pencils, but I would say this compares to a 3B. It can give a pleasing range of tones for sketching, including satisfyingly dark shadows. It’s also perfectly suitable for doing crosswords in the newspaper; much more legible than a standard HB pencil.

It’s a Blackwing

I can honestly say that this is the best pencil I have ever used. It really is that smooth, I think next time I will try the 602 or maybe an extra firm version just to compare. But the pearl really does live up to its name. It is a beautiful tool, and will be on my restock list.

Blackwing Pearl: The Balanced Middle Blackwing Pencil

# Blackwing Pearl: The Balanced Middle Blackwing Pencil

The Blackwing Pearl is the balanced pencil of Blackwing's four core grades: softer than the 602, firmer than the Matte. It has a pearlescent white, pink or blue hexagonal cedar barrel, the flat gold ferrule and a replaceable eraser. Blackwing's Japanese store equates it to about 2B. It launched on May 2, 2013.

Quick answer

By Ellis Penhale · Published October 22, 2026 · 5 min read

On this page 11 sections

The Blackwing Pearl at its listed 20.5 cm, drawn to scale. Original illustration made for this guide. © Stationery Times.

## Product facts

Notes on these facts

- Made by California Cedar Products Company (Cal Cedar), Stockton, California. Made in Japan: Tacto Studio lists the Pearl as made in Japan, and the Amazon US listing names "Made in Japan" among its features. Blackwing's own pages say its pencils use California incense-cedar and premium Japanese graphite but don't name the factory country. Source. Price: example listing. Released: Cal Cedar's April 18, 2013 post introduced the Blackwing Pearl and gave May 2, 2013 as its official debut at Pencils.com and other dealers; The Pen Addict reviewed it on May 23, 2013.
- Every factual fix is dated in the corrections and changes log.
- How we test and disclose samples: How we test stationery.
- Price bands are typical US retail, checked October 2026. Conversions to US dollars are approximate, at October 2026 rates (US$1 = ¥158 = ₩1,330 = NT$32.5 = CN¥6.7 = SEK 9.9 = DKK 6.7 = ₺49.6 = C$1.41 = A$1.43 = CZK 21.7 = NOK 9.5; €1 = US$1.12; £1 = US$1.32; CHF 1 = US$1.21).

## Key takeaways

- Blackwing ranks the Pearl second softest of four core pencils: Matte (soft), Pearl (balanced), 602 (firm) and Natural (extra firm).
- Blackwing's official Japanese store describes the Pearl as soft and roughly equal to 2B.
- Retailers list it at 20.5 cm (8 in) long and 7.5 mm across, sold in boxes of 12.
- Cal Cedar announced the Pearl on April 18, 2013 for a May 2, 2013 debut; the white 12-pack's UPC is 820933110528.
- Its Amazon US 12-pack ranked #17 in Woodcase Lead Pencils with 1,072 ratings on October 22, 2026.

## What is the Blackwing Pearl?

The Pearl is Blackwing’s middle-of-the-road pencil: a balanced graphite that sits between the soft Blackwing Matte and the firm Blackwing 602. Blackwing describes it as smooth and balanced, for writing, journaling and sketching.

It wears the brand’s signature flat gold ferrule and a replaceable eraser, on a pearlescent barrel. Cal Cedar introduced it in April 2013, three years after it revived the Blackwing name, as our Blackwing history explains.

## How soft is the Blackwing Pearl?

Softer than the 602 but firmer than the Matte; Blackwing’s Japanese store gives about 2B. Blackwing’s US site uses words, not letter grades.

The Pearl sits second on Blackwing's scale; letter grades are rough. Original illustration made for this guide. © Stationery Times.

In practice that means a dark line that holds a point a little longer than the Matte. The Pen Addict found the Pearl softer and slightly darker than the 602 in its 2013 review. Our pencil grades explainer covers why one maker’s 2B isn’t another’s.

## Blackwing Pearl specs

| Spec | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Maker | California Cedar Products Company (Cal Cedar), Stockton, California |
| Graphite | Balanced (Blackwing); roughly 2B (Blackwing Japan) |
| Finish | Pearlescent white, pink or blue |
| Ferrule | Flat, gold-colored |
| Eraser | White, replaceable |
| Length | About 20.5 cm (8 in), unsharpened, with eraser |
| Diameter | About 7.5 mm (0.3 in) |
| Wood | Incense-cedar |
| Pack | 12 pencils; the box doubles as a pencil cup |
| UPC (white, 12) | 820933110528 |
| Japan price | ¥6,600 (about US$42) for 12; ¥550 (about US$3.50) for one |
| Made in | Japan (per retailers) |
| Price band | $ (under $5 a pencil) |

The pink 12-pack’s UPC is 820933111532 and the blue’s 820933111549, per Blackwing’s store.

## Pearl, Matte or 602: which should you choose?

Choose the Pearl if you want one Blackwing for everything; the Matte for darker drawing, and the 602 for a point that lasts.

| | Matte | Pearl | 602 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Graphite | Soft | Balanced | Firm |
| Blackwing Japan equivalent | 3B | 2B | B |
| Barrel | Matte black (also green, red) | Pearl white (also pink, blue) | Gunmetal |
| Eraser | Black | White | Pink |
| Length | About 20.5 cm | About 20.5 cm | About 20.5 cm |

All three share the same size and ferrule, so caps, point guards and erasers swap between them.

## How should you sharpen a Blackwing Pearl?

A long-point sharpener suits it; soft graphite breaks less when the point is long and gently tapered. Blackwing sells its One-Step Long Point Sharpener for its pencils, and any sharp hand sharpener works.

The eraser pulls out of the ferrule’s clip, so you can extend it or replace it when it wears down.

## Who is the Blackwing Pearl for?

It suits writers who find the 602 a little pale and the Matte too quick to wear down, because Blackwing calls its graphite balanced between the two.

- Everyday writing: Blackwing says the Pearl suits daily writing and journaling, and at under $5 a pencil it sits in our $ band.
- Drawing and sketching: Blackwing Japan rates the graphite at roughly 2B, softer than the 602’s B, and Blackwing says it suits sketching.

Skip it if you write small and want one point to last a whole page: the 602 or the extra-firm Natural holds an edge longer. If you mostly shade large areas, the Matte lays down graphite faster.

## Is the Blackwing Pearl popular?

Yes: it is one of the best-selling premium wood pencils on Amazon US. On October 22, 2026 the white 12-pack ranked #17 in Woodcase Lead Pencils, with 1,072 ratings averaging 4.7 stars.

That puts it among bulk school packs that cost a fraction as much per pencil. Blackwing also sells the Pearl in single pencils in Japan and in mixed sets with its other core grades.

## Where is the Blackwing Pearl made?

In Japan, according to Tacto Studio and the Amazon US listing. Blackwing says its pencils combine California incense-cedar with premium Japanese graphite but doesn’t name the factory. The brand is American, owned by Cal Cedar of Stockton, California.

## Frequently asked questions

Is the Blackwing Pearl softer than the 602?

Yes. Blackwing calls the Pearl balanced and the 602 firm, so the Pearl lays down a slightly darker, softer line. The Pen Addict also found the Pearl softer and a little darker than the 602.

What HB grade is the Blackwing Pearl?

Blackwing's US site gives no letter grade, but its official Japanese store lists the Pearl as roughly 2B. Treat it as a guide; makers' grades don't match exactly.

What colour eraser does the Blackwing Pearl have?

White, according to Blackwing's Japanese store, under a gold-coloured ferrule. The 2013 original had a black eraser, per The Pen Addict's review, and Blackwing sells replacement erasers in several colours.

Does the Blackwing Pearl come in colours?

Blackwing's US store lists the 12-pack in pearlescent white, pink and blue. All three use the same balanced graphite.

Is the Blackwing Pearl good for sketching?

Blackwing says it suits daily writing, journaling and sketching, and calls it a favourite of calligraphers and illustrators. For darker shading, the softer Matte is the usual pick.

Are Blackwing Pearl pencils made in the USA?

No, retailers say Japan. Blackwing is an American brand from Stockton, California, but Tacto Studio and the Amazon US listing give Japan as the country of manufacture.
